title: Virtual Compute: refund assessment — account receivable
content:
## Applicable basis

Virtual Compute refund assessment — Reconcile the selected holding receivable from all posted charges, credits, debit adjustments, payments, payment returns and refunds across its complete history; pending, rejected and cancelled events do not enter the receivable.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for refund assessment — account receivable?**

Reconcile the selected holding receivable from all posted charges, credits, debit adjustments, payments, payment returns and refunds across its complete history; pending, rejected and cancelled events do not enter the receivable.
